notes.subject: ברך
notes.rationale: Lentšu le ra go lokoša fela, eupša mo go šomišwa bjalo ka mantsu a sephiri go ra go lokoša Elohim — diphetolelo ka moka di kgetha 'lokoša' (KJV, JPS) go feta 'lokoša' ya nnete ya lentšu.

notes.subject: mosadi wa gagwe
notes.rationale: Polelo ye e direlwa Ayobe ka sebele, tlalelo ya mosadi wa gagwe.

notes.subject: ברך/ומת
notes.rationale: Taelo ya go lokoša e latelwa ka go felela — kgopolo ya mosadi e a hlaka, ga go tshwarelo

translation: Gomme mosadi wa gagwe a mmolelela: Naa o sa swaragana le bokgethwa bja gago? Lokoša Elohim, gomme o fele.
